تخابثت (form VI)
# تَخَابَثْتُ (taḵābaṯtu) /ta.xaː.baθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَابَثَ (taḵābaṯa)
# تَخَابَثْتَ (taḵābaṯta) /ta.xaː.baθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَابَثَ (taḵābaṯa)
# تَخَابَثْتِ (taḵābaṯti) /ta.xaː.baθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَابَثَ (taḵābaṯa)
# تَخَابَثَتْ (taḵābaṯat) /ta.xaː.ba.θat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
